# How much do you have to withdraw this year?

> Free RMD calculator for IRAs and 401(k)s. Get this year's required minimum distribution, a year-by-year projection, the cost of delaying the first RMD to April 1, qualified charitable distribution savings and the missed-RMD penalty. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
